story.title: What happens if an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers

draft:
I've been noticing a trend of disillusionment among tech professionals. 
As someone in the software space, I've seen colleagues question their career choices. 
Key drivers include lack of autonomy and unfulfilling work. 
What's driving this trend and how can we address it?
#techcareers #softwaredevelopment #burnout
